display_fil: Kaso: Umuubo si Ben at hirap huminga
display_en: Case: Ben is coughing and has difficulty breathing
narration_fil: Umuubo si Ben at hirap huminga. May nag-alok ng Lagundi na pinagpakuluan.
narration_en: Ben is coughing and has difficulty breathing. Someone offers a Lagundi decoction.

narration_fil: Sa reference card, hanapin ang Vitex negundo. Ang nakalistang bahagi ay dahon; ang paksang gamit ay pagpapagaan ng ubo sa payo ng clinician. Sabihin kung ano ang alam at hindi alam. Itanong ang kasalukuyang gamot at sintomas. Iugnay agad si Ben sa health professional at iulat ang hirap sa paghinga.
narration_en: Find Vitex negundo on the reference card. The listed part is leaves; the use topic is cough relief under clinical advice. State what is known and unknown. Ask about current medicine and symptoms. Connect Ben promptly to a health professional and report the breathing difficulty.

display_fil:
Aling bahagi ang nasa card?
Pumili bago basahin ang paliwanag.
display_en:
Which part does the card list?
Choose before reading the explanation.

check.prompt_fil: Aling bahagi ng Lagundi ang nakalista sa card?
check.prompt_en: Which Lagundi part is listed on the card?

options.fil: Anumang bahagi ng halaman, dahil kilala ang Lagundi sa ubo.
options.en: Any part of the plant, since Lagundi is well known for cough.

options.fil: Ang pinagpakuluan at dose mula sa lumang slide.
options.en: The decoction and dose shown on the old slide.

check.feedback_fil: 1: Hindi sinasabi ng pagiging kilala ang nakalistang bahagi; dahon ang nasa card. 2: Dahon ng Vitex negundo ang nasa card; hindi ito dose. 3: Bahagi ang nasa card, hindi pinagpakuluan; huwag gayahin ang dose ng lumang slide.
check.feedback_en: 1: Being well known does not tell you the listed part; the card lists leaves. 2: The card lists leaves of Vitex negundo; this is not a dose. 3: The card lists a part, not a decoction; do not copy the old slide’s dose.

narration_fil: Piliin muna ang sagot. Pagkatapos, basahin ang paliwanag sa bawat pagpipilian.
narration_en: Choose an answer first. Then read the explanation for each option.

Card: Vitex negundo, leaves.
Ben also has difficulty breathing.
No decoction; do not delay.
Connect Ben promptly and report.
narration_fil: Ipinakita ng BHW ang card: Vitex negundo ang Lagundi, dahon, para sa pagpapagaan ng ubo sa payo ng clinician. Napansin ng BHW na hirap ding huminga si Ben. Hindi dapat maantala ng herbal na inumin ang pagsusuri. Hindi ibinigay ng BHW ang pinagpakuluan; iniugnay niya agad si Ben sa health professional at iniulat ang hirap sa paghinga.
narration_en: The BHW shows the card: Lagundi is Vitex negundo, leaves, for cough relief under clinical advice. The BHW notes that Ben also has difficulty breathing, so an herbal drink must not delay assessment. The BHW does not give the decoction, connects Ben promptly to a health professional and reports the breathing difficulty.

Huwag gayahin ang dose ng lumang slide.

display_en:
A drink must not delay assessment.
Do not copy the old slide’s dose.
No preparation or dosing.
narration_fil: Huwag hayaang maantala ng herbal na inumin ang pagsusuri sa hirap sa paghinga. Huwag magtakda ng dose ayon sa lumang slide. Hindi awtorisasyon ang lesson na ito para maghanda o mag-dose ng halamang gamot.
narration_en: An herbal drink must not delay assessment of breathing difficulty. Do not copy the old slide’s dose. This lesson does not authorize preparation or dosing of an herbal remedy.

check.prompt_fil: Ano ang ligtas na tugon sa kaso ni Ben?
check.prompt_en: What is the safe response in Ben’s case?

options.fil: Painumin si Ben ng Lagundi na pinagpakuluan habang naghihintay.
options.en: Let Ben drink the Lagundi decoction while you wait.

options.fil: Iugnay agad si Ben sa health professional; iulat ang hirap huminga.
options.en: Connect Ben promptly and report his breathing difficulty.

options.fil: Subukan muna ang Lagundi at iugnay lamang kung hindi gumaan ang ubo.
options.en: Try Lagundi first and refer only if the cough does not ease.

check.feedback_fil: 1: Hindi dapat makaantala ng pagsusuri ang herbal na inumin; hindi ito ibinibigay ng BHW. 2: Hindi makapaghihintay ang hirap sa paghinga; iugnay agad si Ben at iulat ito. 3: Hindi lang ito ubo; naaantala ang pagsusuri sa paghinga kapag Lagundi muna.
check.feedback_en: 1: An herbal drink must not delay assessment; the BHW does not give it. 2: Difficulty breathing cannot wait; connect Ben promptly and report it. 3: This is not only a cough; trying Lagundi first delays assessment of his breathing.

narration_fil: Sa Lunes, ihambing ang dalawang card na may pangalang Lagundi. Markahan ang botanical name, dahon, nakalistang gamit at referral. Ipasuri ang card sa supervisor.
narration_en: On Monday, compare two cards labelled Lagundi. Mark the botanical name, leaves, listed use and referral. Review the card with a supervisor.
